description: Allowlist for Next.js API route files. Normal dashboard data access should use the generated backend client or the OpenAPI catch-all proxy instead of adding route files here.

apps/dashboard/app/api/[...backendPath]/.reason: OpenAPI-allowlisted backend proxy for generated-client compatible dashboard calls.

apps/dashboard/app/api/auth/desktop-sign.reason: Desktop auth handoff endpoint that depends on Next/Clerk session context.

apps/dashboard/app/api/calendar/summary/.reason: Server-side calendar summary aggregation with analytics backend dependencies.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/habits/route.reason: Server-side AI habit parsing endpoint that uses provider credentials and compatibility behavior.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/sms/proactiv.reason: SMS proactive chat boundary that adapts Sendblue/backend behavior to dashboard callers.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/sms/route.ts.reason: SMS chat adapter boundary for the shared chat runtime.

apps/dashboard/app/api/chat/stream/route.reason: Streaming chat response boundary that must stay in Next for browser stream semantics.

apps/dashboard/app/api/integrations/oaut.reason: Temporary OAuth code bridge for desktop Whoop and Tesla polling.

apps/dashboard/app/api/sentry-smoke/rout.reason: Local smoke-test endpoint for frontend observability validation.

apps/dashboard/app/api/whisper/route.ts.reason: Server-side Whisper transcription boundary for uploaded audio.
